manual_title: Factory Machinery Faults, Spare Parts, and Repair Procedures

qa_pairs.problem: Hydraulic press making clicking sound and losing pressure
qa_pairs.procedure: 1. Lock out tag out (LOTO) hydraulic power unit. 2. Depressurize system lines. 3. Replace worn seals using Hydraulic Seal Kit A-20. 4. Test pressure at 25 MPa.

qa_pairs.problem: Pneumatic cylinder failing to retract on packaging unit
qa_pairs.procedure: 1. Disconnect 24V DC power supply. 2. Inspect solenoid wiring continuity. 3. Swap out faulty unit with Pneumatic Valve Solenoid 24V from Bin 12A. 4. Verify actuation.

qa_pairs.problem: Extrusion press main drive overheating and vibrating excessively
qa_pairs.procedure: 1. Stop extrusion motor and allow cooling to below 40°C. 2. Remove housing cover. 3. Extract damaged bearing and install High-Temp Bearing SKF-6205. 4. Apply high-temp lithium grease.

qa_pairs.problem: Assembly line conveyor sensor failing to register passing parts
qa_pairs.procedure: 1. Clean sensor optical/inductive face. 2. Check LED indicator status. 3. Replace with Proximity Sensor Inductive M18 from Cabinet 2 if unresponsive. 4. Recalibrate sensing gap to 2mm.

qa_pairs.problem: Billet heater failing to reach target temperature of 475°C
qa_pairs.procedure: 1. Disconnect terminal power leads. 2. Measure resistance across band terminals. 3. Replace defective band with Extrusion Die Heater Band 500W. 4. Run thermal calibration cycle.

qa_pairs.problem: Conveyor belt slipping under heavy load
qa_pairs.procedure: 1. Release tensioner bolts. 2. Remove worn belt and install Drive Belt SPZ-1250. 3. Adjust tension to 450N deflection force. 4. Run empty test loop for 5 minutes.

qa_pairs.problem: Cooling water flow dropping below safety threshold
qa_pairs.procedure: 1. Isolate inlet and outlet valves. 2. Drain pump volute casing. 3. Replace damaged impeller. 4. Prime pump and verify flow rate exceeds 50 L/min.

qa_pairs.problem: PLC control panel displaying communication timeout error
qa_pairs.procedure: 1. Check RJ45 link status lights. 2. Power cycle switch. 3. Replace switch if port matrix fails handshake. 4. Verify IP routing table.

qa_pairs.problem: Pneumatic air pressure dropping rapidly in main header
qa_pairs.procedure: 1. Shut off compressor feed. 2. Unscrew bonnet and replace internal diaphragm. 3. Reassemble and adjust secondary pressure to 8 bar.

qa_pairs.problem: Robotic welding arm halting mid-trajectory with servo fault
qa_pairs.procedure: 1. Engage emergency stop. 2. Inspect cable harness for pinch damage. 3. Replace with Servo Motor Encoder Cable 5m. 4. Clear axis faults on teach pendant.

qa_pairs.problem: Stamping press clutch engaging with severe delay
qa_pairs.procedure: 1. Bleed pneumatic circuit. 2. Remove clogged quick exhaust valve. 3. Install new valve with thread sealant. 4. Test stroke response time.

qa_pairs.problem: Main exhaust fan emitting high-pitched squeal
qa_pairs.procedure: 1. Lock out fan motor. 2. Check pulley alignment with laser alignment tool. 3. Replace worn pulley. 4. Re-tension belt.

qa_pairs.problem: Chemical dosing pump erratic dosing rate
qa_pairs.procedure: 1. Flush system with clean water. 2. Disassemble dosing head. 3. Replace PTFE diaphragm and check valves. 4. Calibrate stroke volume.

qa_pairs.problem: Laser cutting head losing focus during high-speed cuts
qa_pairs.procedure: 1. Clean lens with optical ethanol. 2. Inspect for micro-cracks. 3. Replace with Focusing Lens ZnSe if scratched. 4. Perform auto-focus calibration.

qa_pairs.problem: Roller bearing seizing up on annealing oven conveyor
qa_pairs.procedure: 1. Cool oven zone below 60°C. 2. Unbolt flange mounting blocks. 3. Replace with Flange Bearing UCF-208. 4. Grease with high-temp paste.

qa_pairs.problem: Air compressor oil temperature exceeding 95°C
qa_pairs.procedure: 1. Stop compressor and depressurize sump. 2. Spin off old filter. 3. Install Air Compressor Oil Filter Element and top up synthetic oil. 4. Run test load.

qa_pairs.problem: Packaging sealer bar failing to maintain sealing heat
qa_pairs.procedure: 1. Disconnect heating bar power. 2. Peel off burnt PTFE tape. 3. Clean sealing bar surface. 4. Apply new PTFE Adhesive Heating Tape Roll smoothly.

qa_pairs.problem: Electric overhead crane hoist brake slipping
qa_pairs.procedure: 1. Lower hook to ground level. 2. Remove brake housing cover. 3. Rivet new Hoist Brake Lining Pad Set. 4. Adjust air gap to 0.5mm.

qa_pairs.problem: Automated guided vehicle (AGV) missing magnetic guide tape
qa_pairs.procedure: 1. Power down AGV maintenance switch. 2. Replace bottom-mounted sensor array. 3. Run sensor calibration routine via service tablet.

qa_pairs.problem: Boiler feed water pump motor tripping thermal overload
qa_pairs.procedure: 1. Measure running current across all three phases. 2. Reset relay. 3. Replace Thermal Overload Relay if trip threshold drifts. 4. Verify amp draw.
